Progress, with a paper trail.

This is a selective archive, not a complete record of all AI research. Historical milestones begin in 2021. Weekly checks add official announcements and a bounded selection of recent AI papers.

Dates refer to the linked publication or announcement. Research may be a preprint; company claims are not independent evaluations. Automated entries are labeled and link directly to their publishers.

Sources include arXiv, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Google AI. Weekly checks run on Mondays.
